Hello all.

this is a follow up question to : https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/lavaan/NUGvCsEgoN0

my model is not that complicated( two predictors, one moderator)  but the question remains:

how to i add into the model a continuous moderator variable?  if the answer is no, how would you work around it? 


thank you very much

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: adding continuous moderator variable in path analysis
parts:
If the predictors and moderator are all continuous observed variables, you just calculate product terms as new variables in your data.frame, then add those terms to your model syntax.  If you are modeling latent interactions, check out the help page for ?indProd in the semTools package.

Terry
